summary: Legacy 3-table backfill read each table as its own separate autocommit SQLite statement with no enclosing transaction, violating ADR-0051's stated one-atomic-snapshot guarantee. Reproduced by Doomgoose's external adversarial pass (Kimi K2.7 + Codex) with two live SQLite connections.
